model_annotation: The image displays two line plots comparing the training reward performance of two reinforcement learning methods—“Llama-On-Policy” and “Llama-LUFFY”—on “Easy” and “Hard” training sets, respectively. Both plots share the same x-axis labeled “Steps,” ranging from 0 to 500 in linear scale with major ticks every 100 steps, and the same y-axis labeled “Training Rewards,” ranging from 0.0 to 0.4 in the top plot and 0.0 to 0.2 in the bottom plot, also in linear scale with major ticks every 0.1. In the top plot (“Easy Training Set”), the blue line (“Llama-On-Policy-Easy”) starts near 0.0, rises steeply to about 0.3 by step 100, then plateaus with minor fluctuations around 0.35–0.4. The red line (“Llama-LUFFY-Easy”) follows a similar trajectory, starting near 0.0, rising to ~0.3 by step 100, and stabilizing near 0.4, with slightly more noise and a small dip around step 300. In the bottom plot (“Hard Training Set”), the blue line (“Llama-On-Policy-Hard”) begins near 0.0, rises slightly to ~0.03 by step 50, then declines to near 0.0 by step 100 and remains flat. The red line (“Llama-LUFFY-Hard”) starts near 0.0, rises steadily to ~0.1 by step 100, continues climbing with fluctuations to ~0.2 by step 500, showing consistent improvement despite noise. Both plots include shaded regions around each line, indicating variability or confidence intervals.
